# Official MQL5 source provenance

Repository: https://github.com/artificial-intelligence-edge/lorentzian-classification

Immutable release: `mql5-v1.00`, commit `a23a2301bbad66a6136ffa4b838eceb46ae2db1f`.
Retrieved 6 October 2026 Jakarta time. Source copied byte-for-byte from
`ports/mql5/indicators/`, including porting notes and all dependencies.
MIT license is retained as `LICENSE.md`. The official release source is compiled
locally without edits. It is NOT a verified copy of the Market-delivered binary.

The official predictive inputs remain defaults. Our iCustom call disables only
Show Trade Stats, Show Bar Colors and Show Bar Prediction Values. Our separate
tester-only EA supplies position sizing, VWAP filtering and trailing exits;
therefore this is an original-model comparison, not the author's complete
example EA strategy or Trade Stats display.
